text_blocks.speaker: Harrison Sanford
text_blocks.text: The Toronto Raptors are back in the mix in my opinion as Eastern Conference finalists as they make this move to get Kawhi and really only give up Brandon Ingram, two first-round picks, two seconds, and Gradey Dick. But to me, well, well worth the price.

text_blocks.speaker: Danny Green
text_blocks.text: They gave up quite a bit. That's a good little ticket right there. Kawhi automatically puts you in a different realm, right? Toronto now, if they end up with the lineup, some matchups they had, I would favor them over Cleveland.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Kawhi Leonard's decision to return to Toronto
quotes.excerpt: For a guy in Kawhi to come to Toronto in 2019, be traded there, say, all right, I did my year, I got a chip, I'm out.
quotes.quote: For a guy in Kawhi to come to Toronto in 2019, be traded there, say, all right, I did my year, I got a chip, I'm out. For him to say, okay, now it's the tail end of my career, I'm 35, and this is where I want to go. And yes, of course, he's going to get paid handsomely to do it. But I think for the franchise of the Raptors, for the city of Toronto, for a player of his caliber to say, you know what, this is where I would like to end my career, I love the city, I love our chance to compete. I just think it's a beautiful thing for the whole franchise and the city to embrace as well.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Sanford
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Sanford questions Jakob Poeltl's ability to anchor the Raptors defense
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Jakob Poeltl, particularly from what we've seen from him in the playoffs, is going to be able to hang
quotes.quote: I don't think Jakob Poeltl, particularly from what we've seen from him in the playoffs, is going to be able to hang, particularly if the Knicks can bring back Karl-Anthony Towns and Mitchell Robinson. Obviously, Karl-Anthony Towns is coming back, but that's a formidable front line. You'd want some better front-line play, particularly just as a rebounder. And especially if they go against Giannis and Bam Adebayo, you would hope that you'd have maybe another big man in there at that rotation. So they might be in the market to try and get another big man to really help Poeltl on that side of the ball.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green reacts to LeBron James leaving the Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: The whole Golden State thing, I don't buy this for a second. It'd be nasty for the league.
quotes.quote: The whole Golden State thing, I don't buy this for a second. It'd be nasty for the league. It'd be nasty just to see as a LeBron fan. I would not like it. It'd be fun, I guess, funny or interesting to see him step in those guys, play together, but him in a Golden State jersey would just be nasty to me.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Sanford
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Sanford reports on James Harden's potential sign-and-trade to the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: James Harden did opt out of his player option. There were reports, I believe of some Joe Vardon of the Athletic
quotes.quote: James Harden did opt out of his player option. There were reports, I believe of some Joe Vardon of the Athletic, who said that James Harden can restructure his contract because he opted out of the player option, so he can still get a two-year deal, but he can restructure it. And it's reported by Joe Vardon that Harden is willing to restructure his deal in order to help the Cavaliers get LeBron James.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green predicts a sign-and-trade for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: A sign and trade is going to happen. LeBron James is an all-NBA player still at 42 years old.
quotes.quote: A sign and trade is going to happen. LeBron James is an all-NBA player still at 42 years old. He's an all-NBA player. Just because he didn't make enough games or whatever to qualify, he's an all-NBA player. All-NBA players make 50 to 60 million this year. A cut for him would be 30 or 40. He ain't taking six. That would be absurd. I just don't see a world where that ever happens or LeBron James will allow that to ever happen. He's not one to leave money on the table. I think he's done it once at a hair in Miami, I don't think he'll ever do it again. So it's going to have to be a sign and trade.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Sanford
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Sanford discusses the Cavaliers' need to acquire LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: If you're the Cleveland Cavaliers, you cannot let LeBron James go anywhere but Cleveland.
quotes.quote: If you're the Cleveland Cavaliers, you cannot let LeBron James go anywhere but Cleveland. As a franchise who has the greatest player in the history of basketball, don't start arguing with me now, arguably the greatest player in the history of basketball potentially playing in his retirement season and he doesn't do it in a Cavalier jersey. Do what you have to do and make sure LeBron is this season as a Cavalier. You cannot have him do it anywhere else. That would be a battle for the franchise.
